author: Flexuz_Strafe
body:
Hi, my name ign is: Flexuz_Strafe and I am making my second ban appeal, i was banned for ''autoclicking'' and ''xray'' the xray part is true, but the autoclicker part not at all!!!! i didnt use any type of autoclicker/killaura/forcefield. and btw the first appeal got rejected so that's why I am making my second one. I can promise that i wont hack ever again on the server! I have waited 10 days now so i don't know if that is a reasonable time but i thought trying is never bad!


Yours Truly
Flexuz_Strafe
thanks for looking into my ban appeal :)
